transfer_rules.A0: **A0, resolution.** Index signatures, find the selected root's complete direct call closure, reject recursion or unresolved targets, then analyse callee definitions bottom-up. Catalog effects attach only to matching declarations, never to same-named definitions. Impose resource limits (8 MiB input, 128 selected definitions, 256 blocks per definition, 20,000 selected instructions); exhaustion means `analysis_limit`, not partial acceptance. These are analysis bounds, not program resource bounds.
transfer_rules.A1: **A1, domains.** Allocation generation is `(root, constructor instruction span)`, never numeric address. Root state is `(guard phase, frame phase, G, active chunk sequence, producer set, phase)`. Each `G[g]` has `kind=ScalarList`, exact nonnegative length, exact geometric capacity, token location `Producer(g)` or `Chunk(c,j)`, and `sealed` bit. Pointer SSA provenance is singleton `Param(p)`, `Fresh(g)`, `LengthLens(p)`, `BackingLens(p)`, `SlotLens(p,index)`, or private scalar `Cell(a)`. There is no unknown-pointer acceptance state. One managed owner exists per g; repeated SSA uses are borrows, not extra owner tokens. Backing lenses exist only inside read-only helpers and cannot survive a mutator call. Reject all pointer casts, memory aliases or merges not covered by these lenses/direct parameter substitution.
transfer_rules.A2: **A2, joins/fixed point.** Entry facts seed a forward worklist. Definite initialization joins by intersection; effects/requirements by union. At a join, live pointer facts and guard depth must agree exactly, else reject. Constants/tags join by equality-or-`OtherScalar`; loop-special cells are governed by K, not an optimistic constant join. Use finite sets of program sites/parameters and constant/tag vocabulary; no generated terms or growing counter intervals. Every iteration monotonically removes definite/tag facts or adds effects. Uninitialized/unreachable facts are distinct; recompute until the finite fixed point, then validate every reachable use against the final facts. Validate K/dominance independently before accepting any cyclic CFG. All normal returns must restore guard depth zero. No owner/chunk state ever crosses a branch: the owner root is straight-line.
transfer_rules.A3: **A3, scalars and cells.** Scalar instructions propagate scalar tags only; arithmetic generally returns `OtherScalar` (fold literal-only operations exactly if used for a structural constant). Any ptr/int conversion, scalar encoding of a pointer, scalar-to-pointer conversion, incompatible cell operation, uninitialized load, or cell-address escape rejects. Approved length/slot loads yield scalar payloads and are governed separately by A4. Overflow intrinsics yield scalar pair fields, not memory effects. Their exact LLVM arithmetic/poison semantics remain subject to valid-execution premises. In particular unchecked division/shift validity is not established by an effect summary; the actual check helpers are inspected, and normal successful invocation remains conditional.
transfer_rules.A4: **A4, lenses/borrowing.** A length lens imposes `ScalarList(p)` and emits `ReadList(p), NeedsProtected(p)`; length load returns `Length(p)`. Loading backing imposes the same role, creates only `BackingLens(p)`, and its slot may only be read after the bound guard above. Loaded slot words are scalar because caller instantiation proves `ScalarList`; cannot reinterpret arbitrary reference Lists as scalar. No owning token changes. Borrower calls substitute actual singleton provenance into callee effects/requirements and preserve all owner locations. Local fresh arguments require their active chunk token; external arguments emit a required continuously protected owner outside the selected frame. Two same-role read-only formals may alias through known substitution; inconsistent List/Bytes roles reject. Fresh distinct generations cannot alias each other or an initially live external borrower under the allocator/valid-heap premise. No general alias solver is claimed.
transfer_rules.A5: **A5, guard/frame.** `stack_enter` moves local guard 0→1, `stack_leave` 1→0; guards do not add RC frame tickets. For the owning root, `rc_enter(0)` activates a fresh **activation** f, sets written=0, temporaries empty, F+=1, and may service outside work before activation. Cached physical frame reuse is a new activation ticket. All approved application helper calls have net guard zero and no RC-frame effect, so f remains the current ownership frame. Duplicate/missing leave, nested activation or step before activation rejects.
transfer_rules.A6: **A6, construction.** `list_new()` in active f creates fresh g with kind ScalarList, length/capacity=0, token `Producer(g)` and no V/F. The constructor's preallocation service cannot reference the not-yet-created generation. `list_add(g,s)` requires an unsealed fresh generation, scalar s and the still-valid single producer token; increments exact length. On growth compute the system geometric policy from L:29–69 using checked mathematical arithmetic, including `LARGE_LIST_CAPACITY=4096` from T:182–188; reject size/capacity overflow. This version freezes construction at first keep and rejects later append/mutation. Backing resize is raw storage, not a managed descendant/ticket. Catalog summaries mark possible preallocation service without assuming zero debt.
transfer_rules.A7: **A7, keep.** `rc_keep(g)` requires `Producer(g)`, transfers that token once without retain to the active frame's tail chunk, marks g sealed, removes it from producer set, V+=1. If no chunk or tail occupancy=8, create a fresh logical chunk c, F+=1; append at its next physical slot. Use exact chunk packing from R:327–346, not a guessed one-chunk constant. Keep's preallocation and postregistration polls cannot visit an active chunk. Duplicate keep, keep of borrowed parameter, missing current frame, or later owner use as a producer rejects.
transfer_rules.A8: **A8, automatic service.** Before the closing boundary, constructor/backing/keep service is recorded as `may_service_outside`; it neither consumes local tickets nor changes g's token. Justification: every g has a positive producer or an owner in an **active**, unqueued chunk; no preexisting task can own a newly created nonescaping generation. No incoming scalar word can create an owner edge. This is a symbolic protection argument, not a simulation of pending queues. An unregistered producer is permitted internally during construction, but disqualifies a certificate boundary. No partial aggregate is visible at public call-return boundaries under the summaries; internal C publication steps remain trusted summary premises.
transfer_rules.A9: **A9, boundary discovery.** Require the terminal instruction sequence `rc_step?; rc_leave; stack_leave; ret void` in that exact order, with the step optional and exactly one ownership leave; calls have the exact void signatures. This is the maximal accepted closing suffix. Choose the first instruction of this suffix, not a hard-coded line number. Require no producer, all fresh owners sealed in active chunks, no pointer exports, and all helper calls finished. Reject earlier RC step/poll/release or partial service of the selected component: this version cannot infer an exact remaining cursor after prior local service. A suffix beginning with `rc_leave` alone is also valid since leave detaches temporaries. Record boundary policy; do not silently move it when asked for an unsupported intermediate point.
transfer_rules.A10: **A10, closure transfers.** At t, V is chunk occupancy sum; F is active chunk count plus one active heap-frame activation; Q=R=E=0 for the selected component. `rc_step` requires f active and guard depth one: detach each existing active chunk once and clear the active temporaries; **tickets are conserved**, then automatic service may consume an unknown subset. Mark detached owners unusable in emitted code. `rc_leave` requires f active and guard depth one: detach any still-active chunks and retire f with zero written locals, then automatic service may consume a further unknown subset. No subsequent pointer use, creation, retain, mutation, keep, scalar/helper call or registration is allowed in the suffix. Do not subtract an entire poll return or budget from local W. Closing calls are analysed for promised retirement and total obligations, not for exact post-poll state.

proof_obligations.text: 1. **O1 parse coverage:** typed parsing of every instruction on every selected path; symbol resolution, dominance and CFG reconstruction cannot hide an effect behind lexical variants, unreachable blocks, duplicate declarations or comments. This is not LLVM verification outside the declared subset.

2. **O2 runtime refinement:** each P summary matches all normal branches of the exact C/profile and ordered hidden polls; ownership publication/constructor protection, no reentrancy, correct linking and optimizer preservation remain conditional unless separately proved.

3. **O3 borrower induction:** A1–A4 fixed point is a sound effect overapproximation; immutable List lenses cannot outlive backing changes; every normal return balances guards and exports only scalars. K's invariant/rank covers every backedge/early return.

4. **O4 generation/owner conservation:** induct A5–A8 over prefix instructions. Every successful fresh constructor has one producer, keep consumes it once, all subsequent List uses borrow from active protection, no callee changes current ownership frame, no outside pointer/owner can refer back to g.

5. **O5 boundary/suffix:** A9 finds a stable all-registered boundary and checks its actual continuation; A10 retires exactly these chunks/f, with no later incoming ownership or escaped alias. Returned fresh or external aliases invalidate this subset, including retain-before-return sequences.

6. **O6 cost correspondence:** each remaining occupied slot/chunk/frame activation has exactly one operational visit/finalizer, scalar death is cocharged, cache reuse/retention uses activation identity, and automatic polls count within W without asserting attribution of their whole returns.

7. **O7 external continuation:** Bytes representation, continuously live protecting caller token during all forwarded reads/writes/service, and separation from fresh g are requirements. Actual caller hand provenance is documentary evidence; automatic call-context discharge is out of scope. Full service after return is an additional liveness premise.

8. **O8 provenance and scope:** saved source SHA `8b5d07…`, IR `b7e797…`, compiler binary `995dd6…`, inspected compiler source `994d45…`, runtime C `c4e78f…`, bounded fragment `7d40e4…`, and runtime object `becb74…` are independently pinned. Saved result frontend command and hashes identify the historical producer/profile. Full source→compiler-binary build attestation, compiler correctness and subsequent LLVM/C optimization proof remain unresolved. Application hash mismatch alone does not invalidate semantic inference on a new input; it invalidates claiming that input is the archived original.
